title: Add per-key rate limiting to the public API
body:
Adds a token bucket per API key so one noisy client cannot starve the others.

<!-- Describe how you tested this. -->

## Plan

- [x] Count requests per key in Redis
- [x] Return 429 from the public API middleware when a key is over its limit
- [ ] Tune the limit per plan tier

## Notes

Limits default to 100 requests a minute.
